nodes.blurb: New pages, mail, or map edits.

stages.blurb: Your search hits a nearby front door first, then a query service—not “the whole internet in one database.”
Autocomplete, ranking, and ads are extra services around the same query.
Popular queries are remembered in a cache. The index is the real lookup book.
Snippets and place details sit next to the index, not on your phone.
New pages are fetched in the background. That work is not done while you type.
Builders keep rewriting the index from a cheap store of raw pages.
